title: Special Height Limitation
previewText:
The maximum height of a building or other structure, or portion thereof, shall not exceed 215 feet above curb level, except that:

for qualifying affordable housing or qualifying senior housing in R10 Districts or Commercial Districts mapped within, or with a residential equivalent of such district, the provisions of an R10A District, as set forth in Section 23-432 (Height and setback requirements), shall apply; and

blocks.plainText: The maximum height of a building or other structure, or portion thereof, shall not exceed 215 feet above curb level, except that:

blocks.html:
1. for qualifying affordable housing or qualifying senior housing in R10 Districts or Commercial Districts mapped within, or with a residential equivalent of such district, the provisions of an R10A District, as set forth in Section 23-432 (Height and setback requirements), shall apply; and
  2. energy infrastructure equipment and accessory mechanical equipment shall be permitted obstructions above such height limits, subject to the provisions of Sections 23-41, inclusive, or 33-42, as applicable.

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Housing Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Section renumbered (previously 92-043); aligned height regulations for qualifying affordable and senior housing with underlying rules for R10A Districts; updated cross references
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to expand opportunities for housing within all zoning districts, and across all 59 of the City’s Community Districts
